fullDescription:
Printable flowers monthly planner for teachers, designed by Print Cut Hang.
The planner is without dates.

You will download editable PDF files, and also all pages as separated PNG files.
This monthly planner is intentionally made undated to be used over and over again.

This undated monthly planner contains 6 pages:
– the left and the right floral cover pages
– the left and the right monthly planner – daily scheduler
– the weekly planner – hourly schedule ( right page)
– the calendar 2020 ( left page) – whole year at glance.

Each page size is 8.5 x 11 inches ( letter size):
– weeks start with Sunday
– portrait orientation ( vertical )
– high resolution of 300 dpi…

► More details:
– the cover and the back binder page are fully patterned
– the left and right insert planner pages have a lot of space to type notes and your important daily task
– the month, the year and dates you can enter yourself
– the pages have extra space for punch wholes.

Print them at home or printing office, and make cute last-minute New Years’ gift for family, friends, your customers, coworkers…
The planner will help you to stay organized. At the same time, it is a useful and elegant gift.
This monthly planner with a lot of space to write is perfect as teachers and for students.

You will download:
– 1 PDF file set up to print on tabloid-size papers
– 4 separated PDF file for printing on letter-size papers ( cover, inner monthly planner pager, calendar 2020, hourly scheduler )
– same design as PNG files ( images).

All PDF files can have interactive text forms.
You can use any fonts from your devices.

► More about editable PDF files:
The interactive forms best work with FREE Adobe PDF reader.
You can download the free program from here:

Fonts are not embedded in PDF files. You can use any font from your devices.

HOW TO CHANGE FONT:
– Click on highlighted forms
– press simultaneously CTRL and E keys on your keyboard to open toll box
– in the toolbox, you can change the font, font size and color, and text alignment.

► Printing TIPS:
Printing without margins is recommended. Print to the edge of the paper.

Happy New 2020 year wish you Print Cut Hang ♥
